title: AI Mastery for Working Professionals
discountLabel: 🎉 Launch Offer — 50% OFF for early learners. Limited time.
description:
AI is changing how we work—but most professionals don't know where to begin.

This course is designed to help you move from AI Curious to AI Capable through practical, hands-on learning. Instead of focusing on theory, you'll learn how to use today's leading AI tools to save time, improve productivity, automate repetitive work, and build AI-powered solutions.

You'll explore tools like ChatGPT, Claude, NotebookLM, n8n, GitHub Copilot, Lovable, and more while understanding the concepts behind modern AI, prompt engineering, AI agents, and AI-powered workflows.

Whether you're in business, marketing, HR, finance, operations, consulting, or software development, this course will help you confidently apply AI to your daily work.

For any queries regarding this course or the Approachable platform, email me at ranbeer@gmail.com

What You'll Learn

By the end of this course, you'll be able to:

  • Understand how modern AI and Large Language Models (LLMs) work
  • Master prompt engineering techniques for better AI outputs
  • Use ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and other leading AI tools effectively
  • Build repeatable AI workflows that save hours every week
  • Understand AI Agents and how they differ from chatbots
  • Automate business processes using n8n (no-code)
  • Build simple AI applications using APIs
  • Create AI-powered assistants for research, content, analysis, and customer support
  • Learn the fundamentals of Vibe Coding and AI-assisted software development
  • Apply AI safely using best practices for prompting, validation, and evaluation
  • Stay ahead in an AI-first workplace

Who Is This Course For?

This course is ideal for:

  • Working professionals looking to become AI-ready
  • Managers and team leads who want to improve productivity
  • Product Managers and Business Analysts
  • Consultants and freelancers
  • Entrepreneurs and startup founders
  • Software developers who want to leverage AI coding tools
  • Marketing, Sales, HR, Finance, and Operations professionals
  • Anyone curious about AI but unsure where to start

No prior AI experience is required.

What's Included

  • 🎥 48 recorded videos
  • 📚 5+ hours of structured video content
  • 🛠 Hands-on demos and real-world AI workflows
  • 📝 Quizzes and practical exercises
  • 💻 Capstone project (do on your own)
  • 🤝 Private learner community (coming soon)
  • 📂 Downloadable prompts, templates, and resources
  • 🚀 Lifetime access to course recordings
  • 🎓 Certificate of Completion (Available now!)

Tools we will use in this course

  • ChatGPT
  • Claude
  • NotebookLM
  • GitHub Copilot
  • Lovable
  • n8n
  • OpenAI API

Course Outcome

By the end of this course, you'll have the confidence to use AI in your everyday work, automate repetitive tasks, build AI-powered workflows, and understand where AI can create the greatest impact in your career and organization.

The goal isn't just to learn AI. It's to become AI Capable.

As a software entrepreneur with 18+ years of experience, he now focuses on helping professionals move from AI Curious to AI Capable by teaching practical workflows, automation, and real-world AI applications.

faqs.question: Do I need prior AI or coding experience?
faqs.answer: No. This course is for working professionals with no prior AI background. Whether you're in business, marketing, HR, finance, or software development, you'll learn practical skills step by step — no coding degree required.

faqs.question: Is this live or self-paced?
faqs.answer: This is a fully recorded, self-paced course. You get lifetime access to all 48 videos (5+ hours of content) and can learn on your own schedule, revisiting lessons anytime.

faqs.question: What tools or accounts will I need?
faqs.answer: You'll use ChatGPT, Claude, NotebookLM, GitHub Copilot, Lovable, n8n, and the OpenAI API. Most tools offer free tiers, so you can follow along without expensive software.

faqs.question: How much time should I plan for?
faqs.answer: Core videos run 5+ hours. Budget extra time for hands-on demos, quizzes, exercises, and the optional capstone project. Most learners complete it over a few weeks at their own pace.

faqs.question: Will I get a certificate?
faqs.answer: Yes. A Certificate of Completion is available now. You'll also receive downloadable prompts, templates, and resources to use in your daily work.

faqs.question: What will I be able to do after this course?
faqs.answer: You'll use AI tools confidently, build repeatable workflows, automate tasks with n8n, understand AI agents, and apply AI in your role — moving from AI Curious to AI Capable.
